speed_increase.title: null
commands: /execute if score @s GH.SpeedLevel < @s GH.SpeedLevel.Min run scoreboard players set @s GH.SpeedLevel 1

speed_decrease.title: null
commands: /execute if entity @s[scores={GH.SpeedLevel=5..}] run scoreboard players set @s GH.SpeedLevel 5

waterwalk.title: Water Walk
waterwalk.description: Your speed allows you to run and stand on water.

sprinting.title: null
first_tick_commands: execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.warden.sonic_boom ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 10 1
last_tick_commands: execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.warden.death ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 10 1

speed_decrease_xp.title: null
commands: /execute if entity @s[scores={GH.Speedxp=500000..}] run scoreboard players set @s GH.Speedxp 500000

lightingtosssound.title: null
first_tick_commands: execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.impact ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 10 1

speed_slowness.title: null
commands: /execute if score @s GH.Speedxp < @s GH.Speedslowness run effect give @s minecraft:slowness infinite 3 true
/execute if score @s GH.Speedxp > @s GH.Speedslowness run effect clear @s minecraft:slowness

speed_cap_min.title: null
commands: /execute if score @s GH.Speedxp < @s GH.Speedxp.min run scoreboard players set @s GH.Speedxp -1000

nanocapmin.title: null
commands: /execute if score @s GH.nanolevel < @s GH.nanolevel.min run scoreboard players set @s GH.nanolevel 0

nanocapmax.title: null
commands: /execute if score @s GH.nanolevel > @s GH.nanolevel.max run scoreboard players set @s GH.nanolevel 110
